findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): App performance telemetry export was not observed
findings.evidence: agent.js:44 defines status_code in OpenRouter Fusion error schemas, and agent.js:91 renders the returned HTTP status in run progress. AgentHttpTransport.kt:84,126,142 and 185 log local Android diagnostics. AgentCustomizationUi.kt:239–247 and 360–371 trigger a typed skills.sh search on user action. SkillsDirectoryClient.kt:106–117,300–304 sends the search query, limit and DNT header via HTTPS using OkHttp, with no performance metrics in the observed request. The telemetry label at AgentCustomizationUi.kt:371 describes a CLI flag rather than a telemetry API.
findings.recommendation: Assess the user-entered skills.sh search query separately as optional in-app search data under Google Play Data safety. Keep the discovery UI description aligned with the HTTPS request in SkillsDirectoryClient.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): No dedicated race or ethnicity collection observed
findings.evidence: The race matches in agent.js:55 and 63 use Promise.race to resolve competing operations. The MiniAppGenerator.kt:36 match comes from the word gracefully in bundled rendering instructions. The inference path at MiniAppGenerator.kt:262–271 sends the system instructions and the user prompt, with no race or ethnicity field in the observed request.
findings.recommendation: Cover open-ended user prompts in the appropriate chat or user-generated-content Data safety category. The traced code provides no basis for a dedicated race or ethnicity declaration.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): No dedicated date-of-birth or other-profile collection observed
findings.evidence: The dob substring matches in agent.js:4, 38, 40 and 79 are Zod object identifiers or the Czech localization text for duration. There is no literal dob field or date-of-birth source in the matched code.
findings.recommendation: Cover open-ended prompts and documents under their applicable Data safety categories. The traced patterns provide no evidence of a dedicated personal profile payload.

findings.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Project-file upload can include existing voice or sound recordings
findings.evidence: agent.js:38,40,48,50,51 and 95 uses record for data structures or agent behavior, and agent.js:44 contains SDK input_audio schemas without a matching native audio capture path. MiniAppActivity.kt:676 denies WebView permission requests. Separately, ProjectFilesUi.kt:277 accepts any system-picker MIME type and :255–260 offers an explicit Upload to OpenRouter action. MainActivity.kt:773–774 and :788–793 wire these to OpenRouterFiles.kt:45–49 and :56–61, which copy the full selected file bytes. OpenRouterAgentClient.kt:117–136 posts those bytes as multipart application/octet-stream to the OpenRouter Files API, with the user's Bearer key at :248. Those bytes can include a user-selected recording.
findings.recommendation: Verify the Data safety declaration and privacy policy cover optional project-file uploads, including voice or sound recordings where applicable, and retain accurate file types, purpose, retention and deletion disclosures. Google Play treats off-device transmission as collection, while a specific and reasonably expected user-initiated action can qualify for an exemption from the sharing declaration. See https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10787469?hl=en
